name: Bond County Transit
note: Bond County Transit providing general-public demand-response service across Bond County.

name: Central Illinois Public Transit (CIPT)
note: Regional demand-response service covering seven central Illinois counties.

name: Coles County Dial-A-Ride
note: Coles County Council on Aging operating dial-a-ride across Coles and Douglas counties.

name: Connect FLEX
note: Twin-city microtransit service in Bloomington-Normal metro

name: Danville Mass Transit - Evening Dial-A-Ride
note: Evening demand-response dial-a-ride service covering Danville city.

name: Decatur Moves
note: Countywide service with urban microtransit focus in Decatur-Forsyth-Mt. Zion corridor; rural zones elsewhere in county

name: Henry County Public Transportation (HCPT)
note: Operator states coverage of 'Henry, Stark and western Bureau Counties,' with all trips required to begin or end in Henry County; Kewanee (Henry Co.) is the base of operations. Henry and Stark are full-county coverage; Bureau County service is only the western portion, shown here as approximate/subset of the county boundary. http://www.ride-hcpt.com/service/

name: JCMTD On-Demand
note: Countywide on-demand transit service

name: MCRide
note: Countywide dial-a-ride service coordinated by county

name: MCT Micro
note: Multi-zone microtransit service covering four named municipalities in Madison County area.

name: MetroLINK On-Demand
note: Illinois-side service replacing underperforming fixed routes in two cities

name: MTD SafeRides
note: Nighttime on-demand service in Champaign-Urbana university communities

name: North Central Area Transit (NCAT)
note: Regional transit serving LaSalle County demand-response needs.

name: Pace On Demand
note: Pace On Demand is 11 separate named zones (Batavia; Hoffman Estates; Lansing Area; Naperville-Aurora; Northwest Cook [Arlington Heights-Rolling Meadows]; Round Lake Area; Southeast Aurora; St. Charles-Geneva; Vernon Hills-Mundelein; West Joliet; Wheaton-Winfield), each covering only part of the named municipalities, not full city limits -- e.g. the Naperville-Aurora zone is bounded by I-88, Ferry Rd, Warrenville Rd, Naper Blvd, Gartner Rd, West St, Ogden Ave and Eola Rd (per RTA Chicago blog). No zone-by-zone size or street-boundary data is published for the other 10 zones, so all listed municipalities are used as approximate containing units. Source: https://www.pacebus.com/on-demand ; https://www.rtachicago.org/blog/2022/06/29/pace-introduces-vango-and-expands-naperville-aurora-on-demand-mobility-services

name: Piattran
note: Explicitly described as countywide transportation in Piatt County.

name: Pretzel City Area Transit (PCAT)
note: PCAT operates a countywide service across Stephenson County (over 50,000 trips/year); Freeport is the base of operations, not a narrower zone within the county. https://cityoffreeport.org/pretzel-city-transit/

name: Ride in Kane
note: County-wide coordinated paratransit/DAR service covering Kane County.

name: RIDES Mass Transit
note: RIDES MTD's own site and Wikipedia both name a 17-county southeastern Illinois service area (Clark, Crawford, Cumberland, Edgar, Edwards, Gallatin, Hamilton, Hardin, Jasper, Lawrence, Pope, Richland, Saline, Wabash, Wayne, White, Williamson); the CSV row's '18 Counties' does not match either source, so this uses the confirmed 17-county list -- discrepancy worth a concerns.csv note. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rides_Mass_Transit_District ; https://ridesmtd.com/about/locations

name: SCCTD Flyer
note: First-mile/last-mile service in three named cities connecting to MetroLink

name: SCT Demand Response
note: South Central Transit's site states it serves 'Clinton, Franklin, Jefferson, Marion, Perry, and Washington Counties.' Source: https://southcentraltransit.org/

name: Shawnee MTD
note: Shawnee MTD's site states it serves 'the five southernmost counties in Illinois': Alexander, Johnson, Massac, Pulaski, and Union. Source: https://shawneemtd.com/

name: SMTD Micro
note: Evening/night on-demand zones in Springfield citywide

name: WCMTD Dial-A-Ride
note: Service area described as 'West Central IL (Morgan Co. area)'; treating as Morgan County-wide coverage.
